Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Accha, Riya.

kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

mujhe nahi pata

Khilona sadak ke beech wale spot par khada hai. Us spot ka bhi number hai: 1/2 km, 0 aur 1 ke beech. Wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak ab 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?
